key_insight: The paper shows that neural network accuracy and calibration can be learned jointly in one training loop, removing the need for separate post-hoc calibration.
engineering_relevance: This simplifies deployment by eliminating a dedicated calibration set and extra calibrator optimization, while improving reliability of model probabilities.
method: Formulate calibration as a bilevel Stackelberg optimization problem trained end-to-end with the backbone.
Use standard calibrators such as temperature scaling, matrix scaling, or neural layers within the joint objective.
Find that the final classification layer can act as the calibrator with no extra parameters.
paper_title: Calibration in One Go: Jointly Learning Accurate and Calibrated Neural Networks
